title: Enrollment Orientation for New Students
summary: A walk-through of the enrollment process, programs and scholarships for incoming students and their parents.
description: Meet the registrar, tour the campus and ask questions about programs, fees and scholarships. Bring your parents or guardians. Light refreshments will be served.

title: Christmas Program and Community Dinner
summary: Songs, performances and a shared dinner for students, staff and families.
description: Students and faculty present holiday performances followed by a community dinner. All are welcome.

title: Transferee Information Day
summary: Learn how your earned credits can be evaluated and credited when transferring to Riverside.
description: Bring your transcript of records for a preliminary credit evaluation by our program heads.

title: Science and Innovation Fair
summary: Student research and engineering projects on display, with awards for the best entries.

title: Foundation Day Celebration
summary: Riverside celebrated 28 years with games, a parade and a thanksgiving mass.
